issue_fields._note: Priority/Effort/dates are NATIVE org issue fields (this org's standard), NOT project custom fields. Read defs: GET /orgs/<owner>/issue-fields. Set on an issue/PR: PATCH /repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n> with body {issue_field_values:[{field_id:<id>, value:'<OptionName-string>'}]}.
